correctness.rationale: The proof derives all critical points from 6 Xi(H-G Xi)=0, uses projective-indicator normalization and F(P_S)=k^2(k+t), and checks nondegenerate transverse Hessian with eigenvalues -6k^2 and +6k^2. Smoothness of B is proved from rank of gradients, geometric integrality follows by the genus/Bézout argument in the plane and restriction to a coordinate plane for all n. For n=3 the six A2 delta invariants and node counts give genera 4,1,1,3. Exact symbolic tests independently confirm Hessian identities for dimensions 3 through 7; the all-n proof is mathematical, not based on those finite tests.

value.rationale: This computes the complete location, type, and multiplicity of every nonzero singular wall of a canonical S_n-symmetric pencil of torus sextic hypersurfaces, and identifies exactly two distinct parameter values with integral elliptic normalizations in the plane. The dimension-uniform binomial node law is a structural consequence of the power-sum coordinate geometry and supports future analysis of vanishing cycles, pencil topology, and degenerations; the genus-one basket alone is known and is not the claimed advance.
